QuestInfo.name: The Wolves' Test
QuestInfo.0: You need to go see the pack of wolves that are here to meet #t1902016#. They are apparently waiting at #b#m914030000##k, which is connected to #b#m140010100##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1202008# thanked you for raising their baby pup, but demanded that you return #t1902016# to them. When you told them you weren't interested in returning him, the wolf decided to give you a test to see if you're worthy of raising a wolf. Now you just need to eliminate all the #o9300354#s #p1202008# has summoned.
QuestInfo.2: You passed the test, but #p1202008# still seems to want a word with you...

1.0: Did you defeat all the #o9300354#s? That's amazing. I have the utmost respect for your immense power. You have just passed the test of the wolves.

yes.0: That being said...regardless of the test, if you just bring that kid along for the ride...its life may be in grave danger...

mob.0: You have yet to pass the test. It's simple: #rbeat all of my wolves#k! If you can do that, then I'll accept you.
